api_boundary.request_encoding: strict UTF-8 JSON with duplicate keys, nonfinite numbers, and unknown fields rejected
api_boundary.authentication: signed local JWT authenticates only the subject and one existing lowercase role under the accepted identity policy
api_boundary.authorization: server evaluated for every request and never accepted from caller-supplied identity or role headers

transport_limits.dictionary_import_rule: authenticate and authorize, require a bounded Content-Length, stream exact bytes into a non-executable server quarantine, verify length and digest, then apply the strict dictionary parser; the generic JSON middleware is not bypassed for any other route
transport_limits.virtual_file_write_rule: authenticate and authorize, validate virtual path and expected revision metadata, require bounded Content-Length and SHA-256, stream into the same-root non-executable staging file, then execute the atomic-write contract
transport_limits.content_encoding: identity only; compressed request bodies are rejected

resource_families.mutation_authority: admin for local catalog revision publication only
operator or admin plus namespace WRITE
procedure service principal for LOCAL, ARGS, and IVARS; operator or admin plus namespace WRITE for DATA_CONTAINER
operator or admin plus the exact namespace operation permission
operator or admin plus the exact virtual-root operation permission
resource_families.root_provisioning: virtual roots are provisioned only by the trusted server from an allowlisted owner identity; the public API cannot create, bind, retarget, or expose a host root

permitted: explicit namespace, container, dictionary, and virtual-file mutations
explicit local catalog publication and ACL administration

request_binding_contract.X-Spell-Session-Id: opaque ASCII request-binding value of 16 through 128 bytes
request_binding_contract.X-Spell-Client-Instance-Key-Id: opaque ASCII request-binding value of 16 through 128 bytes
request_binding_contract.binding_rule: store and compare the exact two values with the authenticated subject, request digest, and idempotency settlement; neither header establishes a session, client identity, role, or permission

procedure_service_boundary.transport: internal repository command rather than the browser HTTP mutation route
procedure_service_boundary.binding_rule: the complete binding is authorized, stored, and compared for idempotency; no synthetic browser subject, session, or client-instance binding is accepted

idempotency.identity: authenticated subject, exact bounded request session binding, exact bounded client-instance key binding, operation, resource identity, and bounded idempotency key
idempotency.request_digest: SHA-256 over canonical method, resource identity, expected revision, and body
idempotency.same_identity_same_digest: return the original authoritative status and result
idempotency.concurrent_attempts: one transaction inserts PENDING and owns settlement; concurrent duplicates lock that row and can observe only the final COMMITTED result
idempotency.pending_rule: PENDING exists only inside the mutation transaction and is never returned as success; rollback removes the row and every effect
idempotency.committed_rule: COMMITTED, mutation result, audit record, and outbox event become visible atomically
idempotency.retention_rule: retain every committed settlement for the lifetime of the authoritative data store; never expire, evict, or reinterpret an existing key as a new mutation
idempotency.cap_outcome: at the hard record cap, disable all data mutations and return SERVICE_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED until an explicitly authorized database replacement or release migration increases the bound

authorization_order: validate the signed JWT subject and lowercase role
validate X-Spell-Session-Id as a bounded non-authoritative request binding
validate X-Spell-Client-Instance-Key-Id as a bounded non-authoritative request binding
authorize role, service principal, owner, resource family, operation, namespace or root, and ACL revision
validate request bounds, media type, path or URI, strict schema, expected revisions, and request digest
only then read, insert, wait on, or replay an idempotency settlement

audit_outbox.commit_rule: mutation, result, idempotency settlement, immutable audit record, and outbox event commit atomically
audit_outbox.cap_outcome: disable all data mutations and return SERVICE_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED before accepting another mutation when either hard record cap is reached

security_rules: viewer mutation, spoofed identity headers, stale ACL revisions, stale expected revisions, and unauthorized enumeration are rejected before effect.
Error responses do not reveal existence, current revision, key names, paths, values, digests, or ACL details without matching read authority.
Pagination and filters are typed, allowlisted, cursor-bound, and finite; no generic string query is accepted.
All path and URI values are parsed by their dedicated closed-world contracts before repository access.
Data values, dictionary content, and file bytes are never evaluated or dispatched as code or external effects.
